content:
jordan: starting a regional synapse deploy, planning staggered windows across regions. US -> EU -> APAC. rolling canary, need final capacity thumbs and pin decisions.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: `deployctl start --slice synapse --regions us,eu,apac --canary 0.5% --stagger=regionwise`

maria: running a quick capacity sweep now. current warm GPUs: US 48, EU 36, APAC 22. reserve target is 10% headroom per region. will post exact numbers in 5m.

kevin: +1 to stagger. suggest locking model to v2.3.1 for canary and v2.3.0 fallback. recent perf changes in v2.4 caused throughput jitter.

nina: noted. is there an enforced version pin in the deploy manifest or do we pass it as arg? I can push a hard pin if needed.

jordan: pass as arg for canary: `--model-version v2.3.1 --fallback v2.3.0`. if metrics unstable -> immediate roll to fallback.

sre-ops: capacity readout: post-sweep numbers: US available GPUs 52 (after warm pool), EU 39, APAC 25. Expected sustained token qps headroom @ p95 latency SLO: US 1.8x, EU 1.5x, APAC 1.1x. APAC is tight.

maria: APAC needs temporary burst reservation of 10 GPUs from dedicated pool for first 10 minutes of cutover to avoid cold-start spikes. I can request via infra if everyone agrees.

kevin: agree to burst request. if APAC can't hit 1.2x headroom within 5m of canary, we auto-pause APAC cutover and backfill traffic to US/EU per routing policy. That becomes the rollback trigger.

deploy-bot: canary rollout starting in US (1% traffic) — job id 9b3f. monitoring hooks enabled: perf-metrics, error-rate, token-cost.

nina: smoke checks after first 30s: US p95 latency 240ms (target <= 300ms), errors 0.2% (threshold 1%). looks good so far.

maria: APAC burst request submitted (TICKET-7832). infra says they can grant 8 GPUs for 10m window, pending billing hold.

kevin: billing hold cleared. infra confirmed 8 GPUs allocated to APAC warm pool. thanks maria.

deploy-bot: US canary expanded to 5% after health pass. EU canary scheduled to start in 12 minutes.

jordan: quick note on observability — please keep an eye on model kv-cache eviction rate and memory OOM counters. those tripped once in the last week.

sre-ops: saw one kv-cache spike at 04:17 UTC last week on v2.4, looks resolved by GC. we'll add a temporary alert: `kv_cache_evictions > 50/min` -> P0.

nina: EU canary started. running smoke profile. logs show a few retries on model RPCs but within retry budget. latency p95 EU 290ms.

maria: APAC preflight shows cold-start rate is higher than expected. even with burst GPUs, warm pool needs +4 instances for the first 3 minutes. recommend we delay APAC by 6 minutes to allow warm-up.

kevin: +1 delay, but we should update routing rules to keep traffic pinned to US/EU for that window. jordan can you confirm the routing hold?

jordan: holding APAC cutover for 6m. updating deploy job: `--region-delay apac=360s`. also updating release notes link: https://redwood.company/releases/2026-03-synapse

deploy-bot: EU canary healthy -> expanded to 10%. US/EU combined metrics: p95 260ms, errors 0.3%. no rollback triggers yet.

maria: monitoring heatmaps — CPU temp and GPU thermal throttle counters stable. APAC warm-ups now at expected levels after the 6m delay.

kevin: APAC canary go-ahead from my side. remember fallback policy: if APAC headroom < 1.1x or errors > 1% -> auto-rollback to v2.3.0 and scale down new instances.

deploy-bot: APAC canary starting (1%). job id 9b3f-2.

nina: first 60s APAC: p95 340ms (SLO 400ms), errors 0.6%. kv-cache evictions within threshold.

sre-ops: tracking cost delta during canary: token unit cost up 2.1% for v2.3.1 relative to v2.3.0 due to batching differences. Ops says acceptable for this release.

maria: rolling to 20% across all regions per deploy plan. reminder to product: release notes updated w/ known perf tradeoffs and rollback criteria.

kevin: I'm leaving the channel but set monitoring to auto-escalate to oncall if rollback triggers. good run so far.

deploy-bot: rollout reached 50% global after controlled expansion. autoscale behaved within expected thresholds.

jordan: final checks — file the post-release checklist item for validating model outputs against eval-suite A (run id eval-2026-03-21-synapse). if we see any quality regressions above 0.8% we should trigger a quality rollback.

nina: launching eval-suite A in background, will post summary in 15m.

deploy-bot: rollout complete to all targeted capacity. artifact pinned: v2.3.1. fallback remains v2.3.0.

maria: leaving a note in the release doc: APAC required a short delay + temporary burst to avoid cold-start spikes. capture that for next runbook update.

jordan: great work team, closing thread. postmortem only if rollback or quality regressions occur. :tada:
